units.source_text: 沒過多久，我又在京橋附近的一家小酒館二樓，過起了小白臉的日子。

en.t: Before long, I was once again living as a kept man on the second floor of a small bar near Kyobashi.

units.source_text: 我開始似懂非懂隱約領會了它的含義。

en.t: I began to feel, dimly and only half-understanding, that I was grasping what it meant.

units.source_text: 它是個人與個人之間的衝突，而且是現場衝突，只要當場取勝即可。

en.t: It was a clash between one individual and another, and a clash right there on the spot; all that mattered was winning then and there.

units.source_text: 人絕對不會服從於人，即便是奴隸，也會以奴隸卑屈的方式進行反擊。

en.t: People never truly submit to other people; even a slave strikes back in the abject manner of a slave.

units.source_text: 因此，人除了當場一決勝負外，不會有別的生存之道。

en.t: Therefore, people have no way to survive except by settling the contest on the spot.

units.source_text: 人雖然口頭上標榜堂而皇之的大義名分，但努力的目標必定屬於個人，

en.t: Although people proclaim grand and imposing causes with their words, the goal of their efforts always belongs to the individual,

units.source_text: 超越個人之後還是個人，世人的費解即個人的費解，

en.t: even after going beyond the individual, one still arrives at the individual; the incomprehensibility of society is the incomprehensibility of the individual,

units.source_text: 大海不是世人，而是個人。

en.t: the ocean is not society, but the individual.
